'''Version 1.9.2''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on April 2nd 2022.  It was 9.12 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>New</u> ====

* Global Adaptation from [[Colony|Colonies]]
*# A parasite must be within the range of effect in order to send a signal when killed
*# The signal is the most common damage type it suffered
*# If its killed with fire, it will never send a signal
*# Destroying Colony cores will delete the recorded damage types
*# New parasites spawned in the world will have already learned the damage type that Colonies receive the most

* Potion effect: [[Heightened Senses]]
*# Increases mob follow range

* Potion effect: [[Prey]]

* Block: [[Parasitic Cyst|Canister Active]]
*# Will now consume collected blocks after some time and will spawn particle effect
*# After this process is complete, it will become a non active canister cysth

* Parasite: [[Crux]]
* Parasite: [[Heed]]
* Parasite: [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Assimilated EnderDragon]]
* Parasite: [[Primitive Devourer]] (No Adapted variant yet)
* Entity: [[Scent System|Parasitic Scent]]
* Weapons: [[Living Sword|Living]]/[[Sentient Greatsword|Sentient Sword]], [[Living Cleaver|Living]]/[[Sentient Greatcleaver|Sentient Cleaver]]
* Block remain variant
*[[Commands]]:
*# "srpevolution toogle_evolutiongaining"
*# "srpevolution toogle_evolutionloss"
*# "srpcolonies viewallglobaladaptation"
*# "srpcolonies resetglobaladaptation"

* Items:
*# [[Dried Tendons]]
*# [[Hardened Bone Handle]]
*# [[Infectious Blade Fragment]]
*# [[Living Core]]
*# [[Vile Shell]]
*# [[Strange Bone]]
* Sound effect for:
*# Cutting off [[Adaptation System|tendrils]]
*# Landing hit for bigger jumping parasites
*# Growl, Hurt, Death sound for Marauder

==== <u>[[Scent System|Scent Logic]] (Experimental)</u> ====
To explain how it works I first need you to know some of its <u>Tasks</u> and <u>Values</u>:

* <u>Danger Value</u>:
*# This will go up when a parasite dies within range and as this goes up, the table of mobs to spawn will change
*# If Evolution Phases is on, each time a scent is placed it will have a bonus per phase
*# Some parasites can increase more faster this value when they die
* <u>Reaction Value</u>:
*# This will also go up when a parasite dies within range and this will trigger the placement of waves.

* <u>Task A</u>:
*# The scent will check the <u>reaction value</u> until it reaches a threshold
*# If that threshold is met, it will go into <u>Tactical Mode</u> (This will reset the <u>reaction value</u>)
* <u>Task B</u>:
*# If a non-parasite mob is within range, the <u>reaction value</u> will increase
* <u>Task C</u>:
*# The scent will check the <u>reaction value</u> until it reaches a threshold
*# If that threshold is met, it will go into <u>Attacker Mode</u> (This will lower the <u>reaction value</u>)
*# If the current target is alive, the <u>reaction value</u> will increase (it will decrease if its dead)
*# If <u>reaction value</u> reaches 0, the scent will go into <u>Observer Mode</u>
* <u>Task D</u>:
*# The Scent will try to relocate nearby parasites if avaiable
*# If there are not enough parasites that can be relocated, it goes into <u>Builder Mode</u>.
*# After this is done, this will go into <u>Tactical Mode</u>
* <u>Task E</u>:
*# The scent will try to spawn other scents within a range of its intended target
*# Spawned scents will be in <u>Aggressive Mode</u>
* <u>Task F</u>:
*# This will spawn mobs from a list and then this will be set to dead

With this in mind I can now talk more about its <u>Modes</u>:

* <u>Listener Mode</u>: Will only work Task A
* <u>Observer Mode</u>: Will work Task A, B
* <u>Tactical Mode</u>: Will work Task C
* <u>Attacker Mode</u>: Will work Task D
* <u>Builder Mode</u>: Will work Task E
* <u>Aggressive Mode</u>: Will work Task F<br />
